race.comment: ESTA MIRANDO (11) stepped out to 1705m last start and landed the knockout blow in a strong run from midfield, with the rise in trip again looking to suit her nicely. She gets into this right down in the weights, with the figures she's been running recently holding up strongly. Can repeat the dose. PONY UP (13) comes through the Belmont Oaks and Classic where she held her own behind some handy types, emerging with two Listed placings. She has the speed to work across from out wide and give herself every chance up front. Rates highly on her recent efforts and can get back to winning ways. WITH DISCRETION (15) gets Pike on board today after a disappointing performance back in trip last time. He now rises 700m, though Grantham has been very successful with this set up recently, including CITINO who lines up here. Must be kept safe. KISSES FROM KELLY (3) is racing well and won't be far away. CITINO (2) has to be included on the back of his last start win.
